maya liu: confirm fallback ladder: primary -> quant-7b -> legacy-7b -> serverless-fallback
adrian ramos: small nit — ensure regional fallback prioritizes local replicas first to avoid cross-region failovers.
maya liu: deploy-bot, include pin exemptions in the rollout config. snippet:
```json
{"pins":["acct:acme-inc","acct:beta-enterprises"], "fallback_order":["quant-7b","legacy-7b"], "auto_rollback":{"error_rate":0.005,"p95_ms":700}}
```
deploy-bot: update: pin exemptions applied (roll-id=roll-2162). canary started in us-west1 at t=2162223334.

tim chan: if we see quality drift on sample prompts, run quick rollback command: `/deploy rollback roll-2162`
oliver park: also capture traffic snapshot for later repro: `/deploy snapshot roll-2162 --save-to=/tmp/roll-2162-snapshot.json`
maya liu: ack. tagging @adrian to validate fallback ordering after 30m. :eyes: 
adrian ramos: on it, will validate fallback logs + KV cache hit rates.
